messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
When my eye felt better again, and I put the contact back in, the pain immediately returned.

output.original_text: When my eye felt better again, and I put the contact back in, the pain immediately returned.
output.joy: When my eye finally felt better and I put the contact back in, I was so excited, but the pain came back right away.
output.sadness: When my eye felt better again, I cautiously put the contact back in, only to feel the pain return immediately, and it hurt my heart.
output.fear: When my eye felt better and I hesitantly put the contact back in, I was terrified when the pain immediately returned.
output.anger: When my eye felt better and I stupidly put the contact back in, I was furious to feel that pain hit me again right away.
output.surprise: When my eye felt better and I dared to put the contact back in, I was shocked when the pain returned instantly.
output.disgust: When my eye felt better and I naively put the contact back in, I was repulsed to feel that pain come rushing back.
